paragraphs.text: translated by
1. THIS, even this was my resolve, to win a cow, to win a steed:
paragraphs.original: इति वा इति मे मनो गामश्वं सनुयामिति ।
paragraphs.translit: iti vā iti me mano gāmaśvaṃ sanuyāmiti |

paragraphs.text: Have I not drunk of Soma juice?
2. Like violent gusts of wind the draughts that I have drunk have lifted me
paragraphs.original: प्र वाता इव दोधत उन्मा पीता अयंसत ।
paragraphs.translit: pra vātā iva dodhata unmā pītā ayaṃsata |

paragraphs.text: Have I not drunk of Soma juice?
3. The draughts I drank have borne me up, as fleet-foot horses draw a car:
Have I not drunk of Soma juice?
4. The hymn hath reached me, like a cow who lows to meet her darling calf:
paragraphs.original: उप मा मतिरस्थित वाश्रा पुत्रमिव प्रियम् ।
paragraphs.translit: upa mā matirasthita vāśrā putramiva priyam |

paragraphs.text: Have I not drunk of Soma juice?
5. As a wright bends a chariot-seat so round my heart I bend the hymn:
paragraphs.original: अहं तष्टेव वन्धुरं पर्यचामि हृदा मतिम् ।
paragraphs.translit: ahaṃ taṣṭeva vandhuraṃ paryacāmi hṛdā matim |

paragraphs.text: Have I not drunk of Soma juice?
6. Not as a mote within the eye count the Five Tribes of men with me:
Have I not drunk of Soma juice?
7. The heavens and earth themselves have not grown equal to one half of me
paragraphs.original: नहि मे रोदसी उभे अन्यं पक्षं चन प्रति ।
paragraphs.translit: nahi me rodasī ubhe anyaṃ pakṣaṃ cana prati |

paragraphs.text: Have I not drunk of Soma juice?
8. I in my grandeur have surpassed the heavens and all this spacious earth
paragraphs.original: अभि द्यां महिना भुवमभीमां पृथिवीं महीम् ।
paragraphs.translit: abhi dyāṃ mahinā bhuvamabhīmāṃ pṛthivīṃ mahīm |

paragraphs.text: Have I not drunk of Soma juice?
9. Aha! this spacious earth will I deposit either here or there
paragraphs.original: हन्ताहं पृथिवीमिमां नि दधानीह वेह वा ।
paragraphs.translit: hantāhaṃ pṛthivīmimāṃ ni dadhānīha veha vā |

paragraphs.text: Have I not drunk of Soma juice?
10. In one short moment will I smite the earth in fury here or there:
Have I not drunk of Soma juice?
11. One of my flanks is in the sky; I let the other trail below:
Have I not drunk of Soma juice?
12. 1, greatest of the Mighty Ones, am lifted to the firmament:
Have I not drunk of Soma juice?
13. I seek the worshipper's abode; oblation-bearer to the Gods:
Have I not drunk of Soma juice?
